timestamp_policy: Use the benchmark's local hourly labels. Its authors averaged the repeated autumn hour and interpolated the missing spring hour.
forecast_availability: Use the published day-ahead forecast columns. The CSV omits publication timestamps and revision history.
missing_data_policy: Keep absent hours and missing values as blanks.

columns.delivery_start_local: Hourly delivery label on the benchmark clock.
columns.delivery_day: Calendar date on the benchmark clock.
columns.split: Chronological train, validation, or test window.
columns.price_eur_per_mwh: Observed day-ahead auction price in EUR/MWh. Model target.
columns.load_forecast_mw: Day-ahead grid load forecast in MW.
columns.wind_forecast_mw: Day-ahead wind generation forecast in MW.
columns.load_minus_wind_mw: Load forecast minus wind forecast in MW.
columns.source_row_present: Whether the original CSV contained this hour.
columns.complete_case: Whether price, load, and wind are all present.
